text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —...Ghaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(So... ex... hausting...! I-I can't. No 
more. It's over. Over—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios...! Let's run to the very end, for 
everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Guuuuuh...!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uyaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I loooooost~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, I lost. I couldn't pull off a 
miracle~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Still, Helios. Listen up!
(Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, that was such an exciting race! 
Congrats to the winner!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Helios was totally slaying out 
there, right?! I couldn't take my eyes off 
her for a second!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Great work to you too, Helios!! 
Wooooo～～～～～!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Amazing...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The center of all this fervor is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
âSure, the miracle of victory didn't 
happen. But still! Helios was the one who 
created this vibe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios got everyone hyped up! Isn't that 
amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... hyped to the max...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I'm so jealous, hello!?!? I didn't 
have any fun at all!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I mean, look! It's just...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Near the end, my head was just completely 
filled with... 'I gotta win this for 
everyone!!'"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: My vibes didn't go up at aaaaaall...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can do this. Running for 
someone else's sake is way too exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Ruby and the others have been 
doing this the whole time, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why I've already figured it 
out.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—You and I have completely different ways 
of seeing the world.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...I figured it out. Milady—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's so amazing. To be able to thrill this 
many people.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost as if a miracle has 
happened—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. That person is, without a 
doubt... beyond comprehension.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to run like Helios 
again...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because... I still haven't repaid everyone 
for everything they've done for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to make another miracle happen 
too, and run for everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm the one who's the Miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You can do it. If it's you... I know 
you can run again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I must crawl out of the darkness too. And 
from here, achieve the ultimate 
brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, a result worthy of our 
family name. For everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Shall we make... another promise? This 
time—from me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ――Haha... Too true.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So that's why Milady... cracks up laughing 
at "that," huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Btw, is Ruby actually cracking a huge 
smile!? Whoa, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Palmer-chin, the lady's smile is 
super cute, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! As the ogre!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It made my heart go totally 
thump... thump...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Be struck by love...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, what's wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo smiled. My heart totally skipped a 
beat. But...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She's not like me. Ojo doesn't laugh like 
I do...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You're not smiling at all, 
Palm-chin~~...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll smile. I'll laugh just like 
Helios does. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all for that, I know I 
can! Because Helios and I are besties 
forever!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Are we togevver?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 'Cause we're besties forever, 
aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "We're besties forever."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You two really were besties for life all 
along, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's been like that right from 
the start, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Palmer-chin is my bestie for life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So true☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then let's just laugh it off. And then...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta make some noise, right?!! —'Cause 
this is our party!"
